sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drive" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_node" INTEGER NULL, "target_street" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "driven_m" REAL NOT NULL, "tier" TEXT NULL, "stretch" REAL NULL, "u_turns" INTEGER NULL, "hesitations" INTEGER NULL, "credited" INTEGER NOT NULL, "failed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fixes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gps_gaps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "longest_gap_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "suggested" TEXT NULL, "recoveries" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rescued" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rescued" IN (0, 1)), "start_node" INTEGER NULL, "target_place" TEXT NULL, "most_help" TEXT NULL, "target_lat" REAL NULL, "target_lon" REAL NULL, "graded_from" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER drive_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON drive BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive rows are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER drive_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON drive BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive rows are never deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drive_decision" ("drive_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drive (id), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NULL, "planned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("planned" IN (0, 1)), "ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("ok" IN (0, 1)), "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "help" TEXT NOT NULL, "recent_help" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("recent_help" IN (0, 1)), "hesitated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("hesitated" IN (0, 1)), "key_turn" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("key_turn" IN (0, 1)), "effect" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("drive_id", "seq"));
CREATE TRIGGER drive_decision_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON drive_decision BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive decisions are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER drive_decision_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON drive_decision BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive decisions are never deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drive_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "drive_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TRIGGER drive_event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON drive_event BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive events are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER drive_event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON drive_event BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'drive events are never deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_city" TEXT NULL, "last_area_json" TEXT NULL, "last_difficulty" TEXT NULL, "app_language" TEXT NULL, "street_names" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("sound" IN (0, 1)), "haptics" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("haptics" IN (0, 1)), "home_coach_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("home_coach_seen" IN (0, 1)), "reminder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder" IN (0, 1)), "minutes_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "fsrs_weights" TEXT NULL, "zoom_buttons" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("zoom_buttons" IN (0, 1)), "speed_tolerance_kmh" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14, "drive_home" TEXT NULL, "drive_work" TEXT NULL, "drive_plan" TEXT NULL, "drive_marker" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'arrow', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "round" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "city_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "retry_of" TEXT NULL REFERENCES round (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "answer" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "round_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES round (id), "street_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_lat" REAL NULL, "pin_lon" REAL NULL, "distance_m" REAL NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "round_question" ("round_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES round (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "street_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("round_id", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_day" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "round_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES round (id), PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_known" ("city_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "street_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("city_id", "street_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "badge" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "earned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "seen_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "token" TEXT NULL, "backed_up_at" TEXT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_state" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, "last_review_at" TEXT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_rating" INTEGER NULL, "last_distance_m" REAL NULL, "last_snap_id" TEXT NULL, "prior_known" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prior_known" IN (0, 1)), "intro_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ts" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_m" REAL NULL, "snap_id" TEXT NULL, "rt_ms" INTEGER NULL, "elapsed_days" REAL NULL, "r_before" REAL NULL, "s_before" REAL NULL, "d_before" REAL NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "confusion" ("street_a" TEXT NOT NULL, "street_b" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("street_a", "street_b"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learn_city" ("city_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "placed_at" TEXT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NULL, "work_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("city_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "landmark_personal" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "junction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "approach_edge_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "implicit_evidence" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ts" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_node" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_node" INTEGER NOT NULL, "random" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("random" IN (0, 1)), "items" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "turn_override" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drive_track" ("drive_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drive (id), "track" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("drive_id"));
CREATE TRIGGER review_log_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON review_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'review_log rows are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER review_log_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON review_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'review_log rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER answer_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON answer BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'answer rows are immutable');END
